# DKR-031: Container logs rotate

- **Group:** Docker
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

The default json-file log driver keeps every line forever. A chatty or crash looping container fills the disk, and a full disk takes every service down in a way that looks like an application bug.

## Verify by hand

```sh
cat /etc/docker/daemon.json; docker info --format '{{.LoggingDriver}}'
```

## How to fix it

Set {"log-driver":"json-file","log-opts":{"max-size":"10m","max-file":"3"}} in /etc/docker/daemon.json (or use the local driver) and restart Docker. Existing containers keep their old settings until they are recreated.

## What a fix can break

Restarting Docker restarts containers without live-restore; old log lines beyond the limit are discarded.
